theme.title: The 2020s
theme.subtitle: Recent records
theme.recap: A 41st pick won Finals MVP, an eighth seed reached the Finals and a rebuilding Spurs team lost 18 in a row.

questions.prompt: In 2023 Nikola Jokić became the lowest draft pick ever to win Finals MVP. Where was he picked in 2014?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: He became the lowest-selected player to ever win Finals MVP, being the 41st pick of the 2014 NBA draft

funFacts.text: Denver's championship was its first in nearly half a century as an NBA franchise.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: winning their first championship in franchise history after 47 seasons in the NBA

funFacts.text: The Nuggets became just the second club from the old ABA to win an NBA championship.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: They became the second former American Basketball Association (ABA) team to win an NBA title

funFacts.text: Denver reached its first NBA Finals by sweeping the Lakers in the West finals.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Nuggets defeated the Lakers in four games, marking their first sweep of an opponent

questions.prompt: As an eighth seed, Miami beat Milwaukee in 2023. How many points did Jimmy Butler score in his career-high game in that series?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: scoring a career-high 56 points in a 119–114 victory

funFacts.text: Miami upset Milwaukee, whose regular-season record had made the Bucks the clear betting favorite.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: they faced the Milwaukee Bucks, the team with the best record in the league

funFacts.text: Tyler Herro broke his hand and Victor Oladipo tore a knee tendon in the opening playoff series.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: they lost starter Tyler Herro in game 1 with a broken hand

funFacts.text: Butler later won the East finals MVP as Miami held off Boston's attempted reverse sweep.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Butler was named the Eastern Conference finals MVP

questions.prompt: How many regular-season games did the 2022–23 Heat win before reaching the Finals?
questions.note: 44–38, then a run to the Finals as an eighth seed.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: They regressed from their 53–29 record the previous season and finished with a record of 44–38

funFacts.text: Miami had to survive the play-in tournament to reach the postseason despite finishing seventh in the East.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Miami had to go through two play-in games to extend their season

funFacts.text: The Heat entered the playoffs with the league's worst scoring average and a negative point differential.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the only team in the league to qualify for the playoffs with a negative point differential

funFacts.text: Undrafted players including Caleb Martin and Gabe Vincent supplied vital production around the established stars.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: undrafted players such as Martin, Gabe Vincent, Duncan Robinson, and Max Strus

questions.prompt: Nikola Jokić led the 2023 playoffs in points, rebounds and assists. How many points did he score?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: became the first player in NBA history to lead the league in points (600), rebounds (269), and assists (190)

funFacts.text: Jokić became the first center to win Finals MVP since Shaquille O'Neal two decades earlier.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: becoming the first center to win the award since Shaquille O'Neal in 2002

funFacts.text: Denver relied on Jokić's scoring efficiency after its outside shooters went ice-cold in the clincher.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the Nuggets struggled with their shooting throughout the game

funFacts.text: Jamal Murray came back from a serious ACL injury to play a key role in the championship run.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Jamal Murray returned to the playoffs after a two-year absence caused by injury

questions.prompt: In Victor Wembanyama's rookie year, San Antonio lost how many games in a row?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: lost 18 consecutive games between November 5 and December 15, the longest losing streak in franchise history.

funFacts.text: The Spurs won the draft lottery and made Victor Wembanyama their first overall selection.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: selecting French center Victor Wembanyama as their third #1 pick in franchise history

funFacts.text: San Antonio had previously used first overall picks on two future legends, David Robinson and Tim Duncan.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: after previously selecting Tim Duncan in 1997 and David Robinson in 1987

funFacts.text: Even with the much-hyped rookie, the Spurs missed the postseason for another year.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: were eliminated from playoff contention for the fifth consecutive season
